format.layout: chest-up talking-head; cards ABOVE forehead only; captions on chest; no face cover
format.topBand: cards y56–280 face-safe (chip h≤100, data h≤230)
format.captionBand: ~y1180 Montserrat Black social-hook + keyword pop (max 2 lines)
format.captionStyle: pro karaoke — soft rise/soft/lift enter; dim→accent glow→white settle
format.cards: transparent glass, never opaque black plates

density.cards: 5-8 on ~2min — fewer, punchier cards, not a constant stream

cardPacing.note: User lock (2026-09): every card-host max 3.0s on screen (compress kicker/title/note to fit — punchier copy, not full transcript sentences). No card at all in the first 10s of the video (talking head plays clean, no hero exception). After that, cards land at spaced, roughly-even intervals tied to real transcript numbers — never back-to-back, never a wall of cards. Fewer total cards (see density.cards) beats more cards.

cardRule: IG Reels motion: unique soft|rise|slide|scale; enter 0.42s expo.out; exit 0.38s; no CSS filter blur / no hold breathe (edit-safe scrub)

proCards.note: Variety layer on top of locked glass kit — captions stay Montserrat social-hook

imageGen.tool: nanobanana MCP (.cursor/mcp.json → nanobanana, generate_image, free Google AI Studio key)
imageGen.note: 2026-09: pexels/pixabay stock dropped (no finance/gold-themed footage). Nano Banana can't output native alpha — generate on solid green (#00FF00) bg, then prep_icon_bg.py chroma-keys it transparent. Used for mk-float-icon CONFIG.image only (show-locked shared assets, generated once per icon type).

slots.when: DISABLED — opening hook card + SFX removed (user lock)

igBanner.motion: centered wrap + expo slide-in → Takip Et press → Takip → slide-out
igBanner.note: Never frozen PNG; avatar shared/ig_avatar.png; rebuild writes compositions/instagram-follow-{mid,end}.html

broll.prep: Two paths (2026-09, updated: ZSky API/MCP needs paid Max plan, user declined — cancelled): (1) user drops 8s 9:16 clips in dashboard slots — Labs, manual; (2) user (or agent, if given the file) generates a free clip manually on the ZSky web app (zsky.ai, logged-in free tier, no API/MCP/subscription needed), downloads it, hands it to agent, agent extends 5s->8s with scripts/prep_zsky_broll.py (ping-pong loop). No automated agentFetch — this is a manual download step, same shape as Labs.

mg.note: Motion graphics overlays — not cards; timed via timeline.json mg[]

special.drone: pull-back scale~0.82 + slight rotate ~1.2-1.5s on thesis beat

researchBacklog: chart scrub on one hero number
Lottie coin settle on hero only

tipExplainer.note: Max 2. Prefer verdict|stat over fake @social cards. social only with @cetin.finans

copyRule: Only numbers and claims present in this video's transcript. Never reuse 0907 CDS/faiz text. Animation/look locked; copy is per-topic.
